# add sublime text

Add the `sublime-text` cask — Sublime Text, the author's general-purpose text editor — to the Homebrew toolset so it is installed by `brew bundle` with the rest of the setup. The original reference is the [cask page](https://formulae.brew.sh/cask/sublime-text).
